description.narrative: At start of program, a comprehensive market study will be conducted. Undertake relevant tests/ assessments as per government rules and policies and pass them and get accredation. Those will be provided toolkits and/ or startup kits.

Enrollment will be completed in the first quarter of 2023 in Bahawalpur and Hyderabad.
